$comment: Single source of truth for `node scripts/run.mjs`: what each script is for, who runs it, its flags and exit codes. tests/run.test.mjs fails when a script in scripts/ has no entry here. `notCommands` are the dispatcher and the library modules. `templateOnly` entries are hidden when the script is absent (they are deleted in spawned projects).

audiences.automated: Run by CI or hooks, not for manual use

init.summary: Fill in the template placeholders of a freshly spawned project

flags.description: Project name, one line, at most 100 characters
What the project does, one line, at most 300 characters
GitHub handle or team that must review protected paths; @me does not work
Command that proves the project is healthy; lands in CLAUDE.md and ci.yml
Skip the `gh` lookup that checks the owner exists
Project directory (default: current directory)

exitCodes.meaning: Placeholders filled in, or nothing left to fill in
An input is invalid; nothing was written

check.summary: Report whether a spawned project is ready to use (read-only)

flags.description: Skip the `gh` query for repository secrets and variables
Project directory (default: current directory)

exitCodes.meaning: Something blocks use (leftover placeholder, missing component or required secret)

vendor.summary: List the pinned external components and verify the installed versions (read-only, offline)

flags.description: Print each component with its pinned version and install command
Compare installed versions with vendor.json
Project directory (default: current directory)

exitCodes.meaning: list succeeded, or verify found every component on its pinned version
verify found a missing or differing component, or the subcommand is unknown

staleness.summary: Report which dependencies are behind: the template, vendored components and pinned GitHub Actions (read-only)

flags.description: Project directory (default: current directory)

exitCodes.meaning: A check could not run (wins over 1)

trim-skills.summary: In CI, keep only the named skills under .claude/skills/

flags.description: Skill names to keep; at least one is required
Project directory (default: current directory)

exitCodes.meaning: Skills trimmed, or there is no skills directory

telemetry.summary: Report usage, cost and turns of an agent run from its execution file

flags.description: The claude-code-action execution file
Name of the job in the report (default: unknown)

exitCodes.meaning: Reported, or skipped because the file is missing or unreadable

report.summary: Cost and usage report over many agent runs, from telemetry.jsonl files and/or the artifacts of CI runs (read-only)

flags.description: Read a telemetry.jsonl file, or every *.jsonl under a directory; repeatable (default: ./telemetry.jsonl)
Also download the telemetry-* artifacts of the repository (default: the git remote origin); needs GH_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN or `gh auth login`
Only runs from a date like 2026-11-01 or from the last N days like 30d
Rows of the table: per job label (default) or per week (Monday, UTC)
Print the report as JSON instead of a table

exitCodes.meaning: Report printed (also when there are no records)
Bad input: unknown flag, invalid value, missing file or no data source
GitHub could not be read (no access, rate limit, network or an unreadable artifact)

release.summary: Create the git tag for a template release, but only if it is ready; never pushes

flags.description: The SemVer version to tag
Run every check but do not create the tag
Repository root (default: current directory)

exitCodes.meaning: Refused: version, changelog, template.json, working tree or existing tag is wrong
